# Joseph Cardinale (R): NYS Assembly, District 11

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Joseph Cardinale's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.cardinaleforassembly.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Kwani O'Pharrow](../opharrow-kwani/) (D).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/cardinale-joseph> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

His 2024 campaign site, largely unchanged: its dated posts and footer are from 2024. His NYPD background checks out. The page and his 2026 profile give different family details.

1. Retired NYPD lieutenant commander and owner of Blue Line Pilot Cars match press and Branch profiles.
2. The site says he is a father of three daughters; Branch's 2026 profile lists four children.
